module_summary: Cache controller: receives CPU requests, checks cache via CAM, latches miss/hit path, and orchestrates memory refill or write-through via FSM.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid signal indicating access request.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Ready signal indicating controller can accept CPU request.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Write enable command distinguishing read vs write operations.

anchors.name: cpu_addr
anchors.why: Address from CPU for cache lookup and memory access.

anchors.name: cpu_wdata
anchors.why: Write data from CPU latched for cache/memory operations.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: Response valid signal indicating data ready to return to CPU.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to CPU from cache or memory.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Stall signal indicating controller busy, not ready for new requests.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request signal indicating CPU request forwarded to memory.

anchors.name: mem_we
anchors.why: Memory write enable command for read vs write operations.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Address sent to memory for read or write access.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Data sent to memory for write operations.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge signal indicating data valid.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Data returned from memory on read operations.

anchors.name: mode
anchors.why: FSM state machine controlling cache operation sequence.

anchors.name: found
anchors.why: Cache hit indicator from CAM, gates hit vs miss path.

anchors.name: lat_a
anchors.why: Latches CPU address across multi-cycle cache operation.

anchors.name: lat_d
anchors.why: Latches CPU write data for memory or cache update.

anchors.name: lat_w
anchors.why: Latches write flag, distinguishes read vs write path.

anchors.name: out_r
anchors.why: Result register holding response data for CPU.

anchors.name: bank_q
anchors.why: Cache read data output on cache hit.

groups.name: CPU Request Interface
groups.description: Valid, ready, and command/address/data signals from CPU.

groups.name: CPU Response Interface
groups.description: Valid, data, and stall signals to CPU.

groups.name: Memory Request Interface
groups.description: Request, command, address, and data signals to memory.

groups.name: Memory Response Interface
groups.description: Acknowledge and read data from memory.

groups.name: Control FSM
groups.description: State machine and cache hit flag controlling operation sequence.

groups.name: Request Holding Registers
groups.description: Latched CPU address, write data, and write command.

groups.name: Response Path
groups.description: Result register and cache bank output holding response data.
